comments:
Accesserty DevCheck is intended for preliminary accessibility review. It does not replace professional accessibility audits, assistive technology testing, or human judgement. Automated checks are based on axe-core; simulation, focus path review, PDF checks, and alt text suggestions are provided to help teams identify issues earlier during everyday review.

Chrome Web Store :
https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/accesserty-devcheck/ompbhahmipenipgiiiehbkiibkonoeec?pli=1

Firefox add-ons :
https://addons.mozilla.org/zh-TW/firefox/addon/accesserty-devcheck/
features: Accesserty DevCheck is a browser extension for preliminary web accessibility review. It helps teams run axe-core checks, simulate common access barriers, review focus paths, inspect selected local PDF accessibility signals, and get image alt text suggestions directly in the browser.
title: Accesserty Devcheck
